examples.english: The student eats food for lunch.

examples.arabic: ثم اكلنا الغداء و بعض الخبز
examples.english: Then we ate lunch and some bread.
examples.transliteration: Thumma akalna al-ghadaa wa ba'da al-khubz.

examples.arabic: سألني هل لديك خطط للغداء اليوم يا بطل الطبخ
examples.english: He asked me: Do you have any plans for lunch today, oh cooking hero?
examples.transliteration: Sa'alanī: Hal ladayka khuṭaṭun lil-ghadā'i al-yawma ya baṭala al-ṭabkhi?

examples.arabic: بعد الغداء اجلس مع الاصدقاء واشرب القهوة
examples.english: After lunch I sit with friends and drink coffee.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd al-ghada' ajlis ma'a al-asdiqa' wa ashrab al-qahwah.

examples.arabic: اجتمعت العائلة حول مائدة الطعام الكبيرة لتناول الغداء
examples.english: The family gathered around the big dining table for lunch.
examples.transliteration: Ijtama'at al-'aa'ila hawla ma'idat at-ta'aam al-kabeera litanaawul al-ghadaa'.

examples.arabic: وفي الظهيرة عندما نعود الى المنزل يسالها متى سنتناول الغداء ومع من نقضي وقتا ممتعا
examples.english: And in the afternoon, when we return home, he asks her when we will have lunch and with whom we spend enjoyable time.
examples.transliteration: Wa fī aẓ-ẓahīrati ʿindamā naʿūdu ilā al-manzili yasa'aluhā matā sanatanāwalu al-ghadāʾa wa-maʿa man naqḍī waqtan mumtiʿan.
